rubric.role_summary: Full-stack data scientist on a platform team, designing and implementing production data products—including models, dashboards, and visualizations—for wastewater-process insights.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Full-stack data scientist on a platform team, designing and implementing production data products—including models, dashboards, and visualizations—for wastewater-process insights.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of experience as a collaborative data professional (data scientist, data analyst, or data engineer).
- Academic and professional background pairing data or computer science with environmental or natural science; no specific degree is stated.
- Python proficiency, especially for scientific computing, machine learning, and visualization; the named libraries are examples, not an all-libraries requirement.
- Experience designing data visualizations.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with MRV, wastewater modeling, process-based modeling, geospatial data analysis and modeling, or physics-informed machine learning.
- Experience building for non-technical stakeholders and designing data visualizations.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
